objective: Review the importable helper that converts accepted ready-only handoff-contract metadata into non-executing command argv, estimate-command, efficiency-estimate, and operator-plan metadata, while keeping command execution, operator-plan execution, RTL simulation, compare execution, measurement, timing, runtime/ABI, arbitrary filelist expansion, and automatic allocation out of scope.

review_decision.reason: The implementation matches the reviewed metadata boundary for accepted ready handoff-contract fixture metadata: the public plan-resolution wrapper remains thin, the new support helper accepts only the reviewed ready handoff-contract surface, validates handoff_contract and stage_plan consistency before command or operator-plan authorities, fail-closes not-ready and unsupported metadata without authority calls, and rejects the tested malformed or prepopulated cases before command, estimate, efficiency, or operator-plan metadata can be built.
review_decision.weakest_point: The helper is not a complete adversarial Mapping schema validator: Python bool values can still satisfy the current positive-int checks because bool is a subclass of int. Also, efficiency_estimate is planning metadata, but the underlying helper can include values derived from existing reports when they exist; this gate must not present that object as new measured timing or speedup evidence. Acceptance is therefore limited to non-executing planning metadata, and a hardening definition gate must precede any execution-boundary definition.

accepted_ready_metadata.estimate_metadata_boundary: efficiency_estimate is non-executing planning metadata only; any existing-report-derived values are not new measured timing or speedup evidence from this gate
